title: Technical Content Writer | SEO, AEO & GEO
description:
Experience : 2–3 Years

No of opening - 1

##### **Responsibilities**

Write technical blogs and articles optimized for SEO, AEO, and GEO.

Create technical case studies by collaborating with developers, business analysts, and business teams.

Develop and update website content, including service pages, solution pages, landing pages, and industry pages.

Create LinkedIn posts, social media content, and thought-leadership carousels.

Research technology topics and explain complex concepts in clear business language.

Conduct keyword research, optimize existing content, and improve search visibility.

Proofread, edit, and fact-check content before publishing.

##### **Requirements**

3 years of experience in an IT services, software development, SaaS, or technology company.

Strong understanding of technologies such as AI, APIs, cloud, web and mobile development, databases, DevOps, CRM, ERP, and integrations

Good knowledge of SEO, keyword research, and search intent.

Understanding of AEO, GEO, and AI search visibility.

Excellent English grammar, writing, editing, and research skills.

Experience writing technical case studies, website content, blogs, and social media posts.

Ability to collaborate with technical and business teams.

Content must be original, plagiarism-free, well-researched, and grammatically correct.

Must be able to independently research and write high-quality content without relying on AI-generated drafts.

AI tools may assist with research, but the final content must be natural, factually accurate, and human-edited, and free from generic or repetitive AI-style writing.

Experience in an IT services or software company is mandatory.

If you think, you have strong fundamental values and forward thinking approach to stand apart from the crowd – we are here to help you!!!
  
### **Technical Content Writer**

Experience: 3\+ Years \| No of Openings: 2

  

Job Description


* Write service and landing pages, long\-form blogs, and case studies built on research and internal project demos not surface\-level summaries
* Attend walkthroughs and demos of delivered projects, ask the right questions, and turn what you see into a clear story of problem, approach, and outcome
* Own on\-page SEO for what you write: keyword research, structure, internal linking, meta descriptions
* Hand off publish\-ready drafts to the \[web/marketing] team, and flag existing pages that need refreshing
* Write campaign copy alongside the marketing team email, ads, gated assets
* Present drafts to the marketing team and, for major pieces, to founders; revise on feedback
* Keep voice and positioning consistent across everything we publish
Key Responsibilities


* 3\+ years writing for a technology company, software services firm, or B2B tech agency
* A portfolio of 3–5 published pieces you wrote start to finish, ideally including one case study or technical explainer
* Ability to sit through a project demo, follow what's happening, and ask the questions that produce a usable story
* Working knowledge of SEO fundamentals and at least one research tool (\[Ahrefs / SEMrush / Search Console])
* Strong written English clean structure, no filler, minimal editing needed on a second draft
